overview: Papa Beaver's Storytime is an animated television series tells of a single father beaver of three little beaver children of his own, two sons and one daughter, who would tell them different stories, either a fable or a fairytale to his children and at the end would tell them the moral of the story to teach them a lesson about their actions that have done before the story began.—rocknrollunderdawg
title: Papa Beaver's Story Time

overview: "RWBY VTubing" is an animated V-tuber series featuring Ruby Rose doing a vlog
title: RWBY VTubing

overview: A new and modern adaptation of the Famous Five books written by Enid Blyton.
title: Le Club des 5 : Nouvelles enquêtes

overview: Make friends with Musti, the happy little kitten who is always having a new adventure.
title: Musti

overview: Jump into a watery world of learning and laughter with Bubble Guppies, a hilarious, rockin', interactive show that teaches kids about a wide range of topics--from dinosaurs to dentists, rock & roll to recycling, and colors to cowboys. Through these topics, kids learn about science, math, literacy, and much more in this preschool musical comedy set in a vibrant, aquarium-inspired underwater classroom. Molly, Gil, and their fish-tailed classmates are just like all preschoolers--learning about the world around them through playful investigation. Set within an eye-popping 3D CGI world of swaying kelp forests, fantastical coral reefs, and undersea gardens and featuring original pop, rock, country, and hip-hop music, the show teaches and models school-readiness skills through songs, dances, and lots of laughs. So put on your water-wings, and jump in for learning and laughs with Bubble Guppies!
title: Bubble Guppies

overview: In the year of 3131 Goat calendar, the goats are living happily and peacefully on Green-Green Grassland until the wolf couple moves to the forest on the opposite side of the shore.
title: Xi yang yang yu hui tai lang

overview: A time of wizards, warriors and kings. From this time of fantasy and magic strides Conan. He is a warrior, an adventurer, a conqueror, a hero and a legend. Conan's phenomenal strength overcomes the most dangerous situations he faces. He lives by a chivalrous code that values loyalty, honesty and fairness. Naive in the ways of the world, but filled with boundless energy and youthful enthusiasm, Conan's fabulous quest takes him from untamed hills to trackless jungles to insurmountable mountains, frigid glaciers and rushing rivers. He encounters scheming sorcerers, treacherous snake men and winged creatures. He befriends powerful warriors and seafaring pirates. Conan is a man of action - direct, blunt, fearless and ever willing to combat sorcery. Conan's phenomenal strength and courage conquer any enemy.
title: Conan and the Young Warriors

overview: Welcome to Snack Basue! Delight yourself in this charming snack bar, just five stations away from Hokkaido's largest downtown area, Susukino. Run by the quirky proprietress, Basue, and her junior hostess, Akemi, the place is filled with laughter and smiles from its oddball regulars and walk-ins as they regale tales of their lives. So, pull up a seat and have a drink—is shochu OK?
title: Snack Basue

overview: Eloise is an imaginative little girl living in New York City with her nanny, going on various adventures.
title: Me, Eloise

overview: Yoshizou Yukawa is a passionate hot springs enthusiast—a hot springs hunter who was able to sniff out the source of springs. One day, while searching for a hidden hot spring to revitalize a town, he slips off a cliff and dies. He is then reincarnated into another world by an Inari deity of a small shrine hidden in the rocks. Yoshizou is joined by Inari's messenger princess, Mayudama. The hot spring hunter within Yoshizou is stirred right away, as he takes a bath with Mayudama in the hot spring he just discovered. Then, an elf girl appears...
title: Pioneer Log of the Storied Hot Springs "Alternate World's Springs"

overview: A moose named Moose and his bird pal named Zee is an star characters which is hosted from the channel called Noggin in 2003-2009 and Nick. Jr in 2009-2012, in 2015 until 2019, Noggin relaunched as an app with Moose and Zee hosting.
title: Moose and Zee

overview: Arajin Tomobishi gets caught up in battles among powerful individuals after reuniting with his former friend Matakara Asamine. Meanwhile, the shadow of a colossal demon appears...?!
title: Bucchigiri?!

overview: It all began one day on a sight seeing trip to Cape Canaveral when Max, a precocious little 16-month-old toddler wandered away from his family, crawled into a space capsule on top of a six-storey rocket and was blasted deep into space.
title: Fantastic Max

overview: In the future, humanity wages war with giant humanoid weapons called Titanostrides. Isami Ao of the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force and Lewis Smith of the United States Marine Corps meet on the battlefield in Oahu, Hawaii. An enemy aircraft attacks, scattering their forces. To survive the battle and save their friends, unlikely comrades must find the courage to defeat this new threat.
title: Bang Brave Bang Bravern

overview: By 1874, seven years have passed since the end of the samurai era. A former samurai, Shizuma Orikasa works as a rickshaw driver in Tokyo while looking for his fiancée, Sumie Kanomata, who went missing during the Boshin War. Shizuma thwarts an assassination attempt and joins the newly established police department, where he'll fight to stop dark forces from overthrowing the government.
title: Meiji Gekken: 1874

overview: Three-member family of bears, which consists of the Father Bear, the bear mother and son Cuddly.
title: The Three Bears

overview: Mai's fascination with the unknown leads her to join the Shibuya Psychic Research team, led by enigmatic Kazuya "Naru" Shibuya. Utilizing her burgeoning psychic abilities, Mai will work alongside a spirit medium, a shrine maiden, an exorcist, and a monk to uncover the darkest mysteries and horrors of the unseen.
title: Ghost Hunt

overview: When four friends secretly travel to Dino Earth to study and protect dinosaurs, they face challenges from nature and the mad scientist Bex Hunter.
title: Quantum Heroes Dinoster

overview: Yoru no Kurage wa Oyogenai follows a girl who spends her nights wandering Shibuya, a place "overflowing with identity." Unable to become anyone, the girl's life begins to change following a special encounter.
title: Yoru no Kurage wa Oyogenai

overview: A comedic, pre-school series celebrating the day to day lessons of Chip and his homeschooling family of energetic Chinchillas.
title: Chip Chilla

overview: Fabius, a Roman liberto married to an Egyptian woman, is falsely accused of treason and condemned to death. His baby son saves himself thanks to a white lioness who takes care about him. Emperor decides to exile all of exponents of Mitra Cult, after Mitra's High Priest talks about a prophecy of doom. According the prophecy, evil forces will destroy the emperor's nephew if the chosen isn't there to protect him. The chosen is a dark-skinned boy with a fair-skinned mother.
title: Gladiators: The Tournament of the Seven Wonders

overview: In the Animal Town where humans and animals live together, Iroha who loves animals is very close to her dog Komugi! One day, a mysterious creature GaruGaru goes berserk in her city. In order to protect Iroha, Komugi transforms into a human and even Precure…!? We have to protect such berserk animals! Let's join forces and return the animals to the Niko Garden!
title: Wonderful Precure!

overview: Short, cute and impossibly evil. A delightful comedy, packed with high doses of evil. The Imp is a light-hearted look at trying to square a career spreading the evil -with the mundane demands of the domestic life. The Imp has got the evil self-help guides, the fancy plans, and phobias too numerous to mention. The Imp is evil. He's just not very good at it.
title: The Imp

overview: Rocking robots, bouncing spacebugs and blazing comets… tighten your bolts and buckle your seat belts for the exciting adventures of Rob the Robot! Join Rob – the galaxy's most curious and adventurous robot – as he explores the boundless galaxy one planet at a time with his friends Ema – the alien linguist, TK – the wheeling toolkit, and Orbit – the quirky artist, solving problems, making amazing discoveries and of course having crazy fun along the way!
title: Rob the Robot

overview: They're not just four of the best secret agents in the world, they're a family. Living and working together as an elite special ops undercover unit, they possess unique talents and abilities far beyond those of mortal families. The X's work for the finest secret spy organization in the world, SUPERIOR, which is locked in an eternal struggle with SNAFU, a terrible agency of evil whose vile tentacles of badness reach everywhere. (Yes, even Cleveland.) As a covert force, the X's are second to none. They thwart evildoers. They save the world. They blow stuff up spectacularly. They argue loudly over what to watch on TV. And two of them send the other two to bed early.
title: The X's

overview: To most of Society, Witches are nothing more than myths and legends of a bygone era. However, there are a few people who possess the Witch genome; a gene that may give the person special, supernatural abilities. For them, a secret organization named Solomon (STN) was formed to track and hunt them down before they became a threat to the rest of Society. The story follows the members of the STN-J, the Japanese branch of Solomon. Unlike other branches of the STN, the STN-J captures Witches alive. Armed with a substance called Orbo, an invention developed by Administrator Zaizen, the Hunters subdue the Witches of Japan and send them to a facility called the Factory. It was during one of these Hunts that a member of the team was killed. With morale falling, Solomon Headquarters sends a new Hunter from Italy to join the STN-J as a replacement for the fallen Hunter; a young girl named Robin Sen
title: Witch Hunter Robin

overview: In Piñata Smashlings we meet four friends who have been thrown together by fate to form a team of very, very unlikely heroes. Whether questing across the land unlocking maps or collecting fruities and power ups, these Smashlings are out to save the Piñataverse from the evil Bashlings and level up on fun along the way. Packed with over-the-top Roblox shenanigans, fast-paced comedy, and hilarious hijinks, every episode is a burst of excitement.
title: Piñata Smashlings

overview: Elfquest is a fantasy story about a community of elves and other fictional species who struggle to survive and coexist on a primitive Earth-like planet with two moons.
title: Elfquest

overview: The series follows the reality-bending adventures of a pair of cousin-brothers, Sammy and Raj, as they pause, rewind, fast-forward, and slow-motion their way into a whole host of rowdy laugh-out-loud exploits with a mysterious time-altering app at their fingertips.
title: The Twisted Timeline of Sammy & Raj

overview: Life is never easy if your name is Lola, you're 12 years-old, live in a rundown neighborhood and have a couple of snotty little brothers to look after. Moreover, her world is turned upside down the day Virginia appears in her life. She is a stuck-up little rich girl who has everything: beauty, friends and good grades. Follow Lola and Virginia discovering friendship, love, jealousy, rivalry, betrayal and other day-to-day issues of teens lifes.
title: Lola & Virginia

overview: The Bananas explore their town of Cuddlestown with their best friends Rat In A Hat and teddies - Lulu, Morgan and Amy.
title: Bananas in Pyjamas

overview: Barbie and the Sensations is a 2-part TV miniseries created by DIC Entertainment with Saban Productions featuring popular Mattel character Barbie, and based upon the "Barbie and the Rockers" line of dolls. It first aired in syndication in 1987 with each installment lasting approximately 25 minutes; part 1 was entitled "Barbie and the Rockers: Out of This World" and part 2 was entitled "Barbie and the Sensations: Rockin' Back to Earth". The films were later released on VHS by Hi-Tops Video, and then on DVD by 20th Century Fox Home Entertainment.
title: Barbie and the Sensations

overview: An adorable group of little dinosaur friends explore their world and learn to help each other through laughter and play.
title: L'il Stompers

overview: In the cozy and prosperous Far Forest, predation is prohibited by law, the enforcement of which is strictly enforced by the police. Universal harmony is violated by a brutal crime: an unknown person insidiously consumed the Hare as food. Experienced investigator Badger Sr. and his young talented partner Badgercat take on the case.
title: Барсукот. Очень зверский детектив

overview: A real 'Doctor Ghoulittle'… 12 year old Brady has a unique talent for communicating with monsters. He tirelessly chases after his dream of a world in which men and monsters will be able to live together in harmony. However, integrating monsters into quiet, suburban life is not easy. The adults are terrified but the kids learn to love them and the monsters become pets! Brady never gives up on searching for his own pet monster, last seen making a run for it...
title: Brady's Beasts

overview: A samurai's path leads him to a young waitress whose hometown was destroyed by a dragon. He doesn't want any trouble — but it finds them anyway.
title: MONSTERS: 103 Mercies Dragon Damnation

overview: Children's series which sees Sooty and his friends Sweep and Soo, and mischievous young cousin Scampi, still living backstage in an old theatre from where they embark on fantastic exploits around the world - and beyond.
title: Sooty's Amazing Adventures

overview: The latest animated series to tie in with the popular Barbie toyline, Barbie: Life in the Dreamhouse was produced by Mattel. The series follows a Slice of Life look into Barbie's, well, life in her Malibu dream house, with brief Reality Television-esque asides into Barbie and her friends' thoughts. Barbie attends parties, goes to the beach, dates Ken, hangs out with her sisters, and does all of the sort of things you would expect Barbie to do. What's unexpected is the massive helping of Affectionate Self-Parody, Medium Awareness, and Parental Bonus on display, adding up to a lovingly parodic version of the Barbie universe not completely out of line with her Toy Story 3 depiction.
title: Barbie: Life in the Dreamhouse

overview: Battlefield Friends is a series of animated shorts set in the game world of Battlefield 3 and Battlefield 4. It chronicles the misadventures of four friends and squadmembers, embodying the four soldier classes available in the games. The series often comically attacks/parodies player trends and game mechanics, such as spawnkilling, buggy bipods, Closet Colonels, etc. The series follows four players-a medic, an engineer, a sniper, and a noob. The series incorporates surreal humor mixed with cartoon comedy gags.
title: Battlefield Friends

overview: From the world of Minecraft, the Mob Squad has made a vow to kill Steve.
title: Mob Squad

overview: An exciting adventure with Tish and her imaginary friend Tash!
title: Tish Tash

overview: In a forest filled with cheeky woodpeckers, show-off frogs and sadistic fireflies – keeping it together will be hard for this little pink owl. Is he looking for trouble or is trouble looking for him? Either way, this little owl has no luck. The most innocuous situations always take an unexpected turn for the worst…
title: La chouette

overview: The lush and tropical paradise of Turtle Island is the domain of the wise and benevolent turtle king Tiki and his loyal subjects. They happily dwell on their dream island, but trouble lurks on the horizon in the form of a crew of dastardly pirates intent of seizing Turtle's Island's enormous box of treasure.
title: L'île de la tortue

overview: Life as a little one is a journey of constant discovery, and full of exciting new experiences. So, join Peppa Pig and all her family and friends as they experience the big, wide world through little eyes and have all manner of adventures in their everyday lives.
title: Peppa Pig Tales

overview: Claude follows the adventures of a beret-wearing dog, Claude, and his friend, Sir Bobblysock, in the town of Pawhaven.
title: Claude

overview: The adventures of Doraleous and his associates as they set out to save Nudonia. An animated medieval fantasy comedy exploring a world filled with knights, elves, wizards and dwarfs. If you enjoy league of legends, game of thrones, world of warcraft, cosplay, or just a good laugh check out this animated comedy
title: Doraleous and Associates

overview: Haruka Sakura wants nothing to do with weaklings—he's only interested in the strongest of the strong. He's just started at Furin High School, a school of degenerates known only for their brawling strength—strength they use to protect their town from anyone who wishes it ill. But Haruka's not interested in being a hero or being part of any sort of team—he just wants to fight his way to the top !
title: Wind Breaker

overview: Michel Vaillant is a French racing driver, running for the brand created by his father: Vaillante. He is one of the best drivers in the world, but he still has to deal with internal and external issues in the race.
title: Heroes on Hot Wheels

overview: Wanna fake-date for four weeks? Dojun's life at college is off to a perfect start! Until he meets his roommate, Jaehee, a high school friend whom he may have ghosted. Jaehee claims he's over their unresolved past, but after an accident resulting in a fractured wrist, he makes Dojun a proposition...
title: 4 Week Lovers

overview: A group of international teenage internet enthusiasts are pulled into another dimension and become superheroes.
title: The Seventh Portal

overview: Animated Series based on the Cookie Kingdom Mobil game.
title: Cookie Kingdom: Last Cookie Standing

overview: A Cartoon Network segment showcasing animated shorts directed by Tex Avery.
title: The Tex Avery Show

overview: The city of Senninha and his friends has turned into a race track with diverse environments.
title: Senninha Na Pista Maluca

overview: When Henry was just five years old, he discovered that eating his mother's mushy carrots gave him the extraordinary ability to make his wishes come true. Carrots became Henry's "genie in a bottle", and he was able to do things that most of us only dream about. Three years older, Henry is now eight and his mother's mushy carrots are still having an effect on him. His unusual wishes are often played out with unexpected consequences and his insatiable curiosity invariably spells disaster. While hilarity and high-jinks reign supreme, Henry also learns some of life's lessons along the way. But while Henry has been given the key to unlock universal mysteries, his road to enlightenment is liberally peppered with the incredible and outlandish escapades that only an eight-year-old could dream up.
title: Henry's World

overview: RIMBA Racer is an action-packed animation series revolving around Tag, a talented rookie racer and newcomer to the prestigious RIMBA Grand Prix, a racing competition full of tough rivals, dangerous challenges and hidden agendas.
title: RIMBA Racer

overview: Michel has a secret: his best friend is a vampire. Not a cheap vampire with false teeth and flour on his nose, a real vampire, who lives at night with real monsters, extraordinary adventures. Petit Vampire, for his part, finds the life of Michel, who goes to school every day like all children, much more extraordinary. Every night, Michel rides on the back of Fantômate, the tomato-colored ghost dog, and goes to meet Petit Vampire, Madame Pandora, Le Capitaine des Morts, Marguerite, Claude and Ophtalmo.
title: Petit vampire

overview: B.O.T. (Beastie Observation Transmitter) is a small robot who travels around 5 different worlds collecting sound and picture data from the various Beasties who inhabit them.
title: B.O.T. and the Beasties

overview: Three schoolchildren accidentally find a magic portal in the Holy Trinity Lavra of St. Sergius and are transported into the past. Now their goal is to return home, and to do this they need to go through a wonderful 14th-century forest from the time of the Tatar-Mongol yoke and the Battle of Kulikovo. The teenagers will be helped by St. Sergius of Radonezh.
title: Забытое чудо

overview: Mila's dad runs the only magic pet store in the city - a fantastical place where you can find all sorts of cute and quirky pets who each have their own unique magic powers, and he has gifted Mila the most magic pet of all, Morphle. Mila's dad runs the only magic pet store in the city - a fantastical place where you can find all sorts of cute and quirky pets who each have their own unique magic powers, and he has gifted Mila the most magic pet of all, Morphle. Morphle is an energetic little red creature who can morph into anything: a sweet puppy, a giant truck, a cool dinosaur or anything that Mila's playful mind can imagine. - Mila loves and takes care of Morphle. She shows him everything she knows about the world, and in particular how to have fun. With Morphle's morphing powers and Mila's boundless imagination every day is the most exciting playdate
title: My Magic Pet Morphle

overview: As a descendant of the Deer King, it is Valt's duty to travel the Five Lands and obtain the magic elements in order to save his parents from evil.
title: Valt the Wonder Deer

overview: Leo the Wildlife Ranger features action-packed, animal-centric missions led by enthusiastic and resourceful Junior Wildlife Rangers - the brother-sister duo, Leo and Katie, and their loyal puppy, Hero. They travel around the world helping other Junior Wildlife Rangers with animal rescue and research missions, and uncovering fun and interesting animal facts!
title: Leo the Wildlife Ranger

overview: Symfollies is a magic world. The inhabitants are the musical instruments from a symphonic orchestra. In Symfollies the leading characters are father Bass, mother Celine, their son Stradi and daughter Viola. Or all together: the violin family. Together with the other instruments of the symphonic orchestra, they go through exciting, funny and touching adventures.
title: Symfollies

overview: Habe diese DVD schon vor 10 Jahren (!!!!!!) gekauft, neulich zufällig im Schrank wiedergefunden. Nochmal geguckt, und immer noch über den Unsinn gelacht. Lief damals auf MTV (als es noch MTV gab), dann kam diese DVD mit extrem viel Bonus-Material raus (das auch komplett bescheuert ist, aber wirklich phantasievoll gemacht!). Erstaunlich, dass es die DVD offenbar immer noch als Neuware gibt. Wer ein günstiges, idiotisches Geschenk sucht für jemanden, der Freude an Blödsinn hat und an schwarzem Humor, dem würde ich empfehlen: Zuschlagen!
title: Suicidal Squirrels

overview: Mappy, a retired police mouse, takes a job as a security guard at Nyamco, only to discover it's a cover for a criminal gang led by Goro. He teams up with colleagues Dig Dug and Sky Kid to uncover the conspiracy.
title: Mappy

overview: The plot revolves around Natsuru Senō, a normal high school boy with blue hair. One day he wakes up and found himself turned into a girl. A stuffed tiger "Harakiri Tora" comes to life and tells him that he has been chosen as one of the "Kämpfer", a female fighter. The Kämpfer are destined to fight with other Kämpfer. The story starts when he is attacked by an unknown girl who happens to also be a Kämpfer.
title: Kämpfer

overview: The town of Gamebridge has mixed up with a magical game world. Monsters are running wild, and an evil prince is plotting world conquest. The folks of Gamebridge must turn to an unlikely hero who will save the world.
title: Mix Master

overview: To all Rhodes Island Operators: "Metalcrab Cafe" is opening soon! Hello, Doctor! How do you like a cup of coffee?
title: Kay's Daily Doodles

overview: Welcome to the concrete jungle, where it's a struggle to survive among the animals of the city. Watch Jake the bear, Jenny the cat and their cast of slightly crazy friends as they live, love and try to stay sane in a wild world.
title: Anisava

overview: Fast talking game reviews for The Escapist.
title: Zero Punctuation

overview: Crazylegs Crane is a 16-episode made for television cartoon series produced by DePatie–Freleng Enterprises in 1978 for The All New Pink Panther Show on ABC. In the cartoons that star Crazylegs Crane, he always goes through various misadventures (often accompanied by his son Crazylegs Crane Jr. and often deals with his frenemy, a fire-breathing dragonfly.
title: Crazylegs Crane

overview: Toby is thirteen years old, one and a half millimetre tall and lives in the Tree with his parents. But today he must get away, alone. The awful Joe Mitch has launched a massive manhunt against him.
title: Tobie Lolness

overview: It's well known that becoming a mother is extraordinary; it's an unforgettable adventure; a life-changing experience… In short: it's fabulous! At least, that's what (good) friends, women's magazines and grandmothers on the subway say. Flan! At Anonymous Mothers (insiders say M.A.), a support group for overwhelmed mothers, we talk frankly about motherhood, we talk about our personal experiences, our anxieties, our failures...
title: Mères Anonymes

overview: The further adventures of Littlefoot and his gang learning about the world of dinosaurs.
title: The Land Before Time

overview: A teen named Luo Lie is picked by chance to travel to the Other World and live with someone else's identity. Both major and minor separatist regimes are present in the Other World, danger lurking in every corner. With his determination and the mysterious ability obtained during the soul travel, the home-sicked Luo Lie overcomes numerous obstacles in the turbulent situation. He goes beyond his limits, turning himself into a well-known figure. However, being in a constantly precarious circumstance, cunning schemes are closing in on him. With the help of his childhood sweetheart, who put her life at risk for his sake, Luo Lie, who had no intention of becoming a hero, unexpectedly embarks on the path to becoming one. What awaits him ahead? Is it an irreversible abyss or the light at the end of the tunnel?
title: Lord of All Lords

overview: Jun Xie was the number one assassin in modern earth. His skills and knowledge in the field of assassination were unparalleled, his accomplishments unprecedented, his reputation terrified the entire underworld. However, during a mission to retrieve a mystical treasure, a mishap occurred… He is now Jun Moxie, a sixteen year old super level debauchee, sole heir to the declining Jun family. A family of valiant heroes, left with an old grandpa, a crippled uncle and a debauchee as the sole heir! Accepting the world's criticism and cold stares with a smile, his new journey begins! His life will be carved by his own will! Rise to the top! Evil Monarch Jun Xie! "This cup I toast to those I've killed in my past life. Forgive me, for there is no chance for you to have revenge. Gulp!" "This cup I toast to those whose life I will take in my new life. Forgive me, for you are fated to die by my hands. Cheers!" -Novelupdate
title: Otherworldly Evil Monarch

overview: An animated anthology program of uncut Popeye theatrical shorts from Fleischer Studios and Famous Studios digitally restored to their original forms whenever possible with an announcer giving viewers facts between each cartoon short.
title: The Popeye Show

overview: Welcome to Champignon, a town of wacky world championships every day. From the Shopping Trolley with One Wonky Wheel races to the Flat Pack Furniture Assembly World Championships, our three heroes Spongo, Fuzz and Jalapeña are always up to something completely bonkers. Spongo is a 15-year-old adrenaline-junkie who would rather lose in a spectacular way than take an easy win. Fuzz counteracts him - he'd prefer to sit and meticulously plan out exactly how they'll take home gold. Jalapeña is an aspiring chef and a junk-tech genius with a mad-inventor spark. Trying to thwart their every move is the villainous spoiled rich kid Taylor la Strange, and her cousin sidekick, Dangles. Taylor is a clever engineer, and always has Dangles to do her bidding, often with hilarious results.
title: Spongo, Fuzz and Jalapeña

overview: After a meteor crash, a group of zoo animals transforms into squishy, gooey and stretchy superheroes with special powers and soon takes on evildoers.
title: Heroes of Goo Jit Zu
The Demon Queen Wants to Die
Demon Queen Just Wants to Make Peace

overview: Seven misfit kids thrown together by circumstance, tackling the trials and tribulations of tweenhood with a worldy-wise sense of humor. They face conflict from teachers, parents and each other, but this is not a documentary; in their world almost anything is possible, and technology and even magic can provide solutions -- or make things worse.
title: Clay Kids

overview: From humble beginnings rise four Fruit Ninjas to rediscover the long lost art of Juice Jitsu. Their mission – to unlock hidden powers through the slicing of fruit and to protect their neighbours from bizarre villains they never knew existed! Running a juice stand as a front for the messiest secret service in the world, our ninjas grow to learn that it is what makes you unique (and even a little bit weird) that ultimately makes you strong.
title: Fruit Ninja: Frenzy Force

overview: The colourful characters in this animated comedy series find themselves in all sorts of hilarious situations. Set in a Montreal-like city and suburban neighbourhood, the story features 30-something-year-old hero Ben Hardi, his girlfriend Sophie N'Guyen, his boss Minister Léopold Ouellet, his friend Guy Carneau, his neighbour Mrs. Allaire, newscaster Édith Viens and well-known reporter Tristan Direct.
title: Pérusse Cité

overview: Megamind goes from being a supervillain and the scourge of Metro City to a superhero who's learning on the job. He'll be bringing the audience along for the ride, as Megamind's trusty brainbots will be recording everything, making him the world's first superhero influencer.
title: Megamind Rules!

overview: Animated Louie lived at home with his father, Andy (a grumpy war veteran), mother, Ora, and little brother, Tommy.He also has other brothers and sisters,but they don't appear every time. Each episode began with a live-action appearance of Louie Anderson introducing the show and setting up the plot. The show focused mostly on the funny events of life growing up.
title: Life with Louie

overview: Quirky vlogger Ruby discovers her only channel follower is a space alien from Planet Pudge named Zokie Sparkleby, and they quickly become BFFs. Filming daily adventures, Ruby teaches Zokie about her version of Earth and Zokie works to control his magic.
title: Zokie of Planet Ruby

overview: Evil Con Carne is about a criminally insane brain who is attached to a bear and his disembodied stomach. Most of the jillionaire Hector con Carne's body was destroyed in an accident, but thanks to modern technology his brain and stomach were attached to a stupid, lumbering bear named Boscov. Despite Hector's circumstances he has help from other henchmen such as General Skarr and Major Doctor Ghastley. From Maxwell Atoms, creator of The Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy. Character Guide Hector Con Carne: A very rich man whose body was blown up in an explosion all that was left of him was his brain and his stomach. they were both put into containers and put onto a bar named Boskov. Hector's ultimate goal is to conquer the world. Major Dr. Ghastly: A scientific Genius, who works for Hector Con Carne. She secretly had a Crush on Hector.
title: Evil Con Carne

overview: Discover Nara with the Piplings - De Li, Lau Lau, Nok Tok and Yojojo.
title: Waybuloo
